name: Shri Nathwani Parimal
education: Professional Doctorate in Management Educated at National Institute of Management, Ahmedabad, Gujarat
permanent_address: Vraj, Near Vishwa Umiyadham Umiya Dham Road, Jaspur Village, Ahmedabad - 382721
books: In Hindi, Jharkhand: Meri Karmabhoom; In English, (i) Gir Lion: Pride of Gujarat and (ii) Adorable and Admirable Parimal Nathwani (both in association with Times of India), (iii) ‘Call of the Gir’ and (iv) The One and Only… Dhirubhai Ambani (published in Gujarati, Hindi and English).
social_activities: Founder Chairman and Trustee, Reliance Rural Development Trust (an NGO), which has carried out approximately 6246 works in 5558 villages across 25 districts of Gujarat for rural development; Chairman, Indian Institute of Public Health, Gandhi Nagar;Trustee, Board of Governor's Social Welfare Fund, Gujarat;Chancellor, Shree Bruhad Gujarat Sanskrut Parishad; Member, (i) Nathdwara Temple Board, (ii) Gujarat Ayurved University Development Board and (iii) Board of Governors of Pandit Deendayal Energy University; Founder Director, GEET Foundation, an NGO for promoting environmental and ecological tourism in Gir
hobbies: President, Gujarat State Football Association; formerVice-President, Gujarat Cricket Association; Executive Member, Lions Club of Jamnagar; Member, Rotary Club of Jamnagar; Lifetime Member, Constitution Club of India; over the last 35 years gathered extensive insights and knowledge about Gir lions, Gir fauna and flora as well as the Maldharis residing in and around Gir in Gujarat
countries_visited: Russia, Switzerland, South Korea, Japan, Uganda, Kenya, as a Member of the delegation of the Government of Gujarat led by the Hon'ble Chief Minister; Austria, France, U.S.A., U.A.E., Thailand, China and Europe
other_information: As Vice-President of Gujarat Cricket Association (GCA), successfully planned, monitored, supervised and executed construction of the world’s largest cricket stadium at Ahmedabad, the ‘Narendra Modi Stadium’; very passionate about wildlife, especially GirLions; had been working for conservation and protection of the Gir Lions, the last remaining Asiatic Lions in the world; made a documentary titled ‘Parimal Nathwani : Gir Aur Lion Ko Samarpit Ek Shakhsiyat’; also, published a 12-episode video documentary on Asiatic Lion of Gir called ‘The Pride Kingdom’; Member, Advisory Committee, Gir Sanctuary and National Park, Government of Gujarat
